senses.gloss: f.root of crowfoot (Ranunculus), used as spice, but considered poisonous for beasts.
units: T’bul Yom I, 5 התיאה (ed. Dehr. התייה; Maim.: ‘some say, tiah is the root of asafœtida’).
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:5">Ukts. III, 5</cite> (ed. Dehr. <he>התיה</he>); Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᶜ (not <he>חת׳</he>).

<cite ref="Chullin 58b:15">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>הלעיטה תִּיעָח</he> (Ms. M. <he>היעה</he>; Ms. R. 2 <he>תועה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if he made a beast swallow crowfoot; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:6">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:19">IV</cite>), 19; a. e.
